question: How is the nature of the great womb declared in its feminine aspect?
premises: The great womb has an essential nature.
This nature can be described by a particular state.
It is declared as the state of being female.
inference: The nature of the great womb is declared by the state of being female.
uncertainties: The term pikā is read as a feminine designation in this context.
plain_english: Of the nature of the great womb, it is declared as the feminine state.
